input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right binding Company, and no Contractor right of access to Company systems (Section 1(c) runs the other way, requiring Contractor personnel to comply with Company's security policies). Nothing burdens us, so no redline.

input.quote: Contractor shall be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee or minimum-payment-on-termination is payable by Company; on termination Contractor is paid only for Services actually incurred or earned. Meets the preferred position.
